review_notes: I read the whole file (lines 1–62). bufferedNode is a named wrapper around `SimpleGraph.Walk.getVert` on the chosen buffered path. Its lemmas are the usual specialisations of Mathlib's `getVert_zero`, `getVert_length`, `getVert_injOn` and `getVert_mem_support`. That is a useful named specialisation and does not compete with Mathlib. bufferedGridNode only re-packages the coordinates into `Fin` types, which is a deliberately different representation. A grep of the ContinuumCoulomb directory found these names only in this file (16 occurrences), so there is no sign of a parallel API elsewhere. I found no independent Mathlib concept that the file duplicates. I did not read the imported files in detail, so I could not rule out duplication there.
